first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The soldier in the image-left foreground with their back to the camera, wearing a gray broad-brimmed steel helmet, with an orange-brown upper back and a long gun visible behind the shoulder.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The soldier ahead and to the image-right of Person A, wearing a gray steel helmet and a brownish-tan coat, with a square cloth pack and a long gun on their back; in the clip, this person turns toward Person A and then turns back.

entities.name: trench wall
entities.identification: The reinforced walls on both sides of the passageway, composed of earthen walls, horizontal boards, and wooden stakes, excluding the ground and the sandbags atop the walls.

entities.name: group of other soldiers in the trench
entities.identification: The group of background soldiers in the depth of the passageway and on the image-right, including partially visible people whose steel helmets are not visible, without redundantly including separately numbered people.

entities.name: muddy passageway ground
entities.identification: The grayish-brown, uneven muddy ground between the trench walls.

entities.name: brown sandbags atop the wall
entities.identification: The brownish-tan elongated rounded bag-like objects stacked horizontally in layers atop the walls on both sides.

entities.name: exposed mound of earth atop the wall
entities.identification: The rough-surfaced mound of exposed brown earth behind the sandbags and rising above the top of the wall.

entities.name: grayish-white sky
entities.identification: The low-saturation grayish-white sky area above the outlines of the wall tops and the mound of earth.

entities.name: trench cable
entities.identification: Multiple slender, dark overhead cable segments sagging downward between the utility poles, recorded as a group.

entities.name: utility pole
entities.identification: The vertical pole-like installations extending into the sky behind the mound of earth, one of which has upper and lower crossarms.

entities.name: soldier's long gun
entities.identification: The group of long guns in the image; the entries for this clip primarily check the exposed brownish-tan elongated portions and dark metal upper ends behind Person A and Person B.
